# Fourier series

A function $f$ on $[0, 2\pi]$ has coefficients $`\hat f(n)`$:

$$
\hat f(n) = \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi} f(x)\, e^{-inx}\,dx
$$

See [Parseval](Fourier%20series%201f2e3d4c5b6a79881726354a5b6c7d8e/Parseval%202a3b4c5d6e7f80918a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b.md), and back to [Research](../Research%200a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9.md).

- Convergence (a toggle)
    
    In $L^2$, always.
